brief.scope: Inspect harness configuration only for the owner-directed agy installation. Map where executable, flags, permissions, model selection, attribution, transcript paths and telemetry adapters are currently declared or hardcoded. Distinguish shipped runtime from unimplemented proposals. Recommend one minimal configuration change that makes agy an ordinary worker selection and future additions simpler, using existing loader/adapter homes. Preserve explicit model selection and current three harness behavior; no role recommendations, benchmarks, conductor activation, Symfony dependency, new executor or framework rewrite. Return exact affected paths, dependency boundaries and independent regression cases inline, with measured commands/ref. No edits, inference, settings/credential access or full floor. Note any issue outside scope that changes the recommendation. The deliverable is a short implementation decision, not an open-ended architecture study.

artifacts.decision: Recommend one small configuration extension: declare selectable workers and their executable overrides through ops/lane.conf and the existing ops/conductor/tools/laneconf.py loader. Replace the fixed wrapper allowlist with this validated selection. Keep invocation, permissions, isolation and parsing in their existing adapter homes; configuration selects implemented adapters and cannot confer capability. Preserve current defaults for all three harnesses. Register agy after its adapter and independent evidence exist; an entry alone is insufficient.

artifacts.affected_paths_boundaries: Configuration change: ops/lane.conf, ops/conductor/tools/laneconf.py, ops/conductor/tools/dispatch.sh and ops/devlane/dispatch/launch.py. Ag y adapter prerequisites, spelled agy in implementation: ops/devlane/dispatch/CONTRACT.md, ops/devlane/harness/isolation.py, ops/devlane/harness/probe.py and ops/devlane/telemetry/usage.py; pulse.py needs its corresponding reporting reader. artifacts.independent_regression_cases: Separate test producer: ops/conductor/tests/test_laneconf.py and test_dispatch_wrapper.py cover configuration precedence, unchanged legacy selection, explicit agy model forwarding, unknown/unimplemented worker refusal, missing model and executable arguments containing spaces. ops/devlane/dispatch/tests/test_launch_isolation.py and test_launch_harness_fixes.py preserve all three fresh/resume argv, prompt transport, permissions and Claude write refusal. test_launch_record_identity.py covers observed/requested mismatch and provider attribution. test_launch_watch.py covers missing stream, timeout and output-cap trips. Harness tests cover isolated-home custody and unresolved evidence refusal. Telemetry tests use synthetic agy sessions for session association, malformed/missing usage and resume accounting. These are proposed cases, not executed or approved tests; require version-stamped live probes and independently verified mocks before agy admission.
